message.content:
{
  "screen_decision": "exclude",
  "screen_rationale": "The study evaluates the concordance of a 3D human cell culture model with human clinical outcomes, not the concordance of animal models with human clinical outcomes. The text explicitly states that animal models have low reproducibility and translatability, and the focus is on developing an in vitro model.",
  "arm": "disease-biology",
  "arm_evidence": "The study focuses on developing and characterizing a 3D human plasma-derived culture model (HuP3D) to mimic breast cancer and predict treatment responses, rather than evaluating the predictive value of animal models for human clinical outcomes.",
  "therapeutic_areas": [
    "oncology"
  ],
  "areas_evidence": "The study title and text repeatedly refer to 'breast cancer (BCa)' and its treatment responses.",
  "model_type": "across-multiple-models",
  "model_evidence": "The study compares its novel 3D human plasma-derived culture model (HuP3D) to 2D cell cultures and literature data from other 3D models, including patient-derived xenografts (PDX), to assess predictive value.",
  "species": [
    "not-species-specific"
  ],
  "species_evidence": "The study uses human cell lines and human plasma-derived cultures, and compares its findings to human clinical data. No non-human animal species are used as models for prediction.",
  "endpoint_class": "mixed",
  "endpoint_evidence": "The study reports on various drug metrics including IC50, EC50, Emax, AUC, Einf, GR50, GEC50, GRmax, GRAOC, and GRinf, which are a mix of measures of drug effect and concentrations."
}
